ranked.headline: Generative and optimal-transport models infer regulatory structure from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial profiles are being modeled with time-varying, perturbation-aware, and weakly linked multi-omic methods.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked sequencing workflows span nanopore, long-read, and single-cell assays
ranked.summary: Sequencing and informatics methods are increasingly judged against reference data, including GIAB, bulk TCR-seq, and CITE-seq tools.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide readouts infer repair, origin and instability in cancer genomes
ranked.summary: Single-cell and long-read sequencing now resolve ongoing instability, somatic haplotypes and locus-level methylation in tumors.

ranked.headline: Fitted control policies and neural models validated against kinematic and neural data
ranked.summary: Simulation-based and Bayesian fitting now links control policies and network structure to kinematic and neural recordings.

ranked.headline: Lipids and ligands reshape protein energy landscapes and conformational dynamics
ranked.summary: Refined force fields, enhanced-sampling MD and coarse-grained models now resolve membrane- and ligand-coupled energy landscapes against experimental data.

ranked.headline: Omics-based models predict reactogenicity and stratify sepsis and IBD patients
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply goal-specified penalized and subgroup models to multi-omics data, moving prediction beyond generic classifiers.

ranked.headline: Computational tools refine copy number, variant effect, and sequencing artifact calls
ranked.summary: Newly posted methods add subgroup calibration, phenotype conditioning, and pharmacogenomic guideline linkage to variant interpretation from sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Generative models steer nucleic acid and peptide sequence design toward targets
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply optimization, reward, and conditioning objectives to steer sequence generation for RNA, mRNA, and peptides.

ranked.headline: Biological priors shape DNA, protein, and enzyme language model representations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints embed conservation, taxonomy, and lineage context into sequence models for design, annotation, and kinetic prediction.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict molecular, protein, and drug interaction endpoints
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs learned molecular and protein representations with task-specific deep models, evaluated on held-out splits and hit-rate metrics.

ranked.headline: Workflow tools automate drug repurposing, variant interpretation and protein design
ranked.summary: Natural-language agents and reproducible pipelines are lowering the coding barrier for network, genomic, and omics analyses.

ranked.headline: Animal genomes reveal selection, convergence, introgression and constraint signatures
ranked.summary: Genome-scale comparisons now test convergence, adaptive introgression, and constraint with explicit computational tools and models across animal lineages.

ranked.headline: Calibrated fine-mapping and cell-resolved QTL models refine genetic association claims
ranked.summary: Recent fine-mapping, axis-QTL, distribution-QTL and polygenic interaction methods now resolve genetic effects by cell type, distribution and phenotype context.

ranked.headline: Explicit observation models linking surveillance and serology to infection inference
ranked.summary: Wastewater, serology, and simulation-based inference studies now pair each data-generating process with a matched estimator.

ranked.headline: Genomic tools tested against defined references in metagenomics and viral discovery
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications add validated pipelines for host-read removal, GC bias correction, and structure-guided viral RdRp discovery.

ranked.headline: Modeling measurement artifacts sharpens isoform and chromatin-mark regulatory inference
ranked.summary: Perturbation screens and spike-in ChIP-seq expose isoform- and normalization-level variance as sources of inference error.

ranked.headline: Computational models couple mechanical load to cell injury and ECM remodeling
ranked.summary: Multiscale mechanical models are being used to connect tissue-scale stress with cellular injury and adhesion mechanics.

ranked.headline: Spatial and multi-omic profiling links tumor states and niches to patient outcomes
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell multi-omics now resolve coordinated tumor states and niches that track with clinical outcome across tumor types.

ranked.headline: Graph and higher-order structure used to infer disease-associated molecular features
ranked.summary: Omics analyses increasingly encode network and higher-order structure to recover disease-linked molecular features beyond pairwise tests.

ranked.headline: Quantitative models tie somatic mutation and mitochondrial fission to aging and cancer
ranked.summary: Explicit simulation and survival models now quantify mutation burden, menopausal shifts and organelle dynamics as constraints on aging and cancer incidence.

ranked.headline: Data construction and negative-set design determine reliability of binding predictions
ranked.summary: Recent work shows reference-data construction and negative-example sourcing largely determine how reliable computational binding predictions are.

ranked.headline: Memory-lean algorithms scale genome-wide ancestry, alignment and diversity analyses
ranked.summary: Growing genomic datasets demand inference and alignment tools whose memory and runtime scale to thousands of haplotypes and 100,000 taxa.

ranked.headline: Differentiable and graph-aware methods for genotyping, phasing and ancestry inference
ranked.summary: Pangenome graphs and population-scale marker data are prompting formulations that learn model parameters or infer genotypes and phase jointly.

ranked.headline: Model-derived bistability links in vitro kinetics to in vivo protein aggregation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints derive discrete outcomes from reduced models, including cell-level bistability linked to disease onset in protein aggregation.

ranked.headline: Taxonomy-guided feature engineering and metabolic modeling for microbiome analysis
ranked.summary: Taxonomy-aware feature engineering, metabolic interaction prediction and interoperable R tooling are arriving together for microbiome data.

ranked.headline: Index layers over compressed genomic data enable scalable k-mer and FASTQ access
ranked.summary: Preprints and a proteomics study target how index and storage layers govern analysis at million-genome and raw-data scale.

ranked.headline: Retrieval-conditioned embeddings extend from protein structure search to sequence design
ranked.summary: Inverse-folding embeddings and retrieval stages are being paired with contrastive and diffusion models for structure search and sequence design.

ranked.headline: Interpretable sequence models decode regulatory syntax and binding determinants
ranked.summary: Transparent architectures now expose which motifs, positions, and sequence features drive regulatory predictions across enhancers, TFs, and miRNA targets.

ranked.headline: New computational methods for longitudinal microbiome, transcriptomic, and clinical data
ranked.summary: Longitudinal, cross-platform, and incompletely sampled data require methods that model subject-specific dynamics, platform differences, and missing values.

ranked.headline: Deep learning quantifies tissue and cell structures in histology and microscopy images
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark pathology foundation models and generate synthetic brightfield images to improve cell detection in histology and microscopy.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and language models recover enzymes that prior annotation missed
ranked.summary: Learned sequence representations now recover enzyme function that prior annotation tools missed, including bacterial peroxygenases expressed in E. coli.

ranked.headline: Spatial dependence modeled explicitly to infer gene co-expression in transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell transcriptomes increasingly require models that encode spatial dependence and tissue correspondence directly in the inference.

ranked.headline: Multi-omic layers integrated to predict cancer survival and radiation response
ranked.summary: Combining transcriptomic, proteomic, microRNA and methylation layers in survival and feature-selection models sharpens cancer outcome prediction.

ranked.headline: Accelerating structure-based drug discovery workflows with ML and enhanced sampling
ranked.summary: Expensive binding, interaction, and design calculations are being shortened by machine learning, enhanced sampling, and automated workflows.

ranked.headline: Mycobacterium tuberculosis uses intrinsically disordered, fast evolving proteins to interact with conserved host factors.
ranked.summary: Benchmarks disorder predictors; links M. tuberculosis IDRs to virulence and host interactions across 540 bacteria; releases IDR database.

ranked.headline: Deep learning extracts structures from cryo-ET, cryo-EM and 4D microscopy data
ranked.summary: Pretrained foundation models and task-specific tools now segment, classify and track biological structures across cryo-ET, cryo-EM and 4D microscopy.

ranked.headline: Structure-guided computational design optimizes enzymes, antibodies and MAGL inhibitors
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply structure-conditioned computation to enzyme, antibody, and hit-to-lead optimization.
